name: vt-hello-grids

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: The C4 handshake and the grids a returning core learns (D19): hello is the first message on the socket, answered by hello_ack carrying proto_version, engine and the grids the worker holds. The VT worker keeps every grid when a core's socket closes, so a core that reconnects — a restart-core, or a core that lost and redialed the socket — sends hello again and hello_ack.grids tells it what survived, rather than the core assuming an empty worker. The second hello is the same socket, not a new run: the worker's grids are still there. Graded against the U4 worker and the U2 core (owed).
